en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty Twelfth Chapter
Regarding the discourse on one in their seventh existence:
Should it not be said that "for a person in their seventh existence, the miserable destinies have been abandoned"?
“Could a person in their seventh existence be reborn in hell, be reborn in the animal realm, or be reborn in the sphere of hungry ghosts?
Therefore, for a person in their seventh existence, the miserable destinies have been abandoned.
The Discussion on the Person in Their Seventh Existence is finished.
restraint, action, and likewise non-restraint; all action with its result; sound as a result; the six sense bases as a result;
the person who is "seven-times-at-most" is fixed in his seven-times-at-mostness; the person who goes from family to family is fixed in his going-from-family-to-family state.

A person who is a single-seed attainer is fixed by that single-seed state; a person endowed with right view might intentionally deprive a living being of life, yet for a person endowed with right view, the miserable destinies have been abandoned; and it is the same for one who has reached the seventh existence.
